    internal static class QuartzDeclaredJobs

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds every job this assembly declares, and every schedule those jobs declare.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="builder">The scheduler being built.</param>
        /// <returns>The same builder, so that the call chains.</returns>
        public static global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder AddDeclaredJobs(this global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder builder)
        {
            builder.AddJob<global::App.PollJob>(job => job
                .WithIdentity("PollJob"));

            builder.AddTrigger<global::App.PollJob>((services, trigger) => trigger
                .WithIdentity("PollJob")
                .ForJob("PollJob")
                .WithSimpleSchedule(simple => simple
                    .WithInterval(ConfiguredInterval(services, "Jobs:Poll:Interval", global::System.TimeSpan.FromTicks(6000000000))) // 00:10:00
                    .RepeatForever()));

            builder.AddTrigger<global::App.PollJob>(trigger => trigger
                .WithIdentity("warm-up")
                .ForJob("PollJob")
                .WithPriority(8)
                .WithDescription("four quick polls as the host starts")
                .WithExecutionGroup("io")
                .WithSimpleSchedule(simple => simple
                    .WithInterval(global::System.TimeSpan.FromTicks(50000000)) // 00:00:05
                    .WithRepeatCount(3)
                    .WithMisfireInstruction(global::Quartz.SimpleTriggerMisfireInstruction.FireNow)));

            return builder;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The same as <c>AddDeclaredJobs</c>, under a name no other assembly's registration shares, so

        /// <param name="builder">The scheduler being built.</param>

        public static global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder AddDeclaredJobsFromSnippet(this global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder builder)
        {

        /// <summary>
        /// The interval configured at <paramref name="key" />, or <paramref name="declared" />, the
        /// attribute's own, where the key is not set or no configuration is registered.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="services">The scheduler's view of the container.</param>
        /// <param name="key">The attribute's <c>ConfigurationKey</c>.</param>
        /// <param name="declared">The attribute's interval.</param>
        /// <returns>The interval the trigger fires on.</returns>
        /// <exception cref="global::System.FormatException">The configured value is not a positive invariant <c>TimeSpan</c>.</exception>
        private static global::System.TimeSpan ConfiguredInterval(global::System.IServiceProvider services, string key, global::System.TimeSpan declared)
        {
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration? configuration =
                services.GetService(typeof(global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration)) as global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration;

            string? configured = configuration?[key];
            if (configured is null)
            {
                return declared;
            }

            global::System.TimeSpan interval;
            if (!global::System.TimeSpan.TryParse(configured, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out interval) || interval <= global::System.TimeSpan.Zero)
            {
                throw new global::System.FormatException(
                    "The configuration key '" + key + "' holds '" + configured + "', which is not a positive TimeSpan. "
                    + "Spell the trigger's interval the way TimeSpan does, invariantly: \"00:10:00\" for ten minutes, \"1.00:00:00\" for a day.");
            }

            return interval;
        }
